Back on a compliance readiness review now.

Let me know if anything looks off. Rewrote parts of security/redaction.py as well. Least-privilege IAM roles for the workers? Taken care of. CSP headers on all rendered responses went smoothly in the end.

Plan for a compliance readiness review?
Rewrote parts of api/auth.py as well. The error messages are now clearer.
Don't let moving the remaining secrets out of environment files slip through the cracks.
Half the afternoon went to an API key committed to the repository history.

Let me know if anything looks off. The root cause turned out to be an open redirect on the login return URL. We can stop worrying about session invalidation on password change now. Parameterised queries across the data layer went smoothly in the end.
